_comment: Pipeline configuration. Fill all TODO values before first run.

apify._comment: Each source is either a saved task (pre-configured input) or a raw actor. The post scraper is a task; confirm actor slugs against https://apify.com/store before running.

post_scraper._note: Saved Apify task. Runs with its own saved input (the influencer profile list lives in the task). Keep config/influencers.json in sync with the task's configured profiles so stage-1 tagging matches.

heyreach._comment: HeyReach public API (https://api.heyreach.io/api/public, auth header X-API-KEY). Campaign/list IDs are NUMERIC — create the campaigns in the HeyReach UI, then paste their numeric ids. sender_linkedin_account_id is the numeric id of the sending LinkedIn account (POST /linkedinaccount/GetAll to find it); it is required when adding leads to a campaign.

operations._comment: Public API paths. Verified shape against HeyReach API docs (Settings > API); endpoints could not be smoke-tested from this environment because outbound egress to api.heyreach.io is blocked by the network policy.

limits._comment: Hard rate limits — agent must not exceed these regardless of queue size.
